facts.fact: The DGSSI page presents Loi n° 43-20 on trust services for electronic transactions as the regime fixing the rules for trust services, cryptology means and services, and trust service providers and certificate holders, and setting the powers of the national trust services authority; the page gives no date, so the law's published date of 2020-12-31 is used. The law covers trust services (signatures and certificates) rather than online selling.
facts.system: Loi n° 43-20 relative aux services de confiance pour les transactions électroniques
